paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum ahong bei a kumpipate kidou ding a akuankhiak lai un, Joab in asepaih hatte apikhia hi. Ammon suante gam asuhsak a, Rabbah khua a-um uh. David bel Jerusalem ah a-om hi. Huan Joab in Rabbah khua asual a, alata hi.
heading: David In Rabbah Ala / (2 Sam 12.26-31)
english: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.

paite: Huchi in David in akumpipa uh lallukhu khuk lai alaksak a, agikdan dangka-eng talent khat ahi, suangmantamte leng atel a; David akhusak ua; khopi a om gallak sum tampi ala hi.
english: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.

paite: Huchi in huai lai a mipite bel apikhia a, sing-atnate, leilehna sikzumte, heipite in nna asemsak hi. Huchibang in Ammon tate khopi tengteng David in ahih hi. David leh mi tengteng Jerusalem ah apai nawnta uhi.
english: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai nung in, Philistia mite toh Gezer ah kidouna a-om a; huchi in Husat mi Sibbekai in milian suante lak a mi Sippai athat a; huchi in avuallelta uhi.
heading: Philistia Miliante Toh Kidouna / (2 Sam 21.15-22)
english: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.

paite: Philistia mite toh kidouna a-om nawn a; Jair tapa Elhan in Git mi Goliath unaupa Lahmi athat a, ateikung chiampek bang ahi.
english: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

paite: Gath ah kidouna a-om nawn a, huai ah misang mahmah, akhut lang tuak a khutzung guk, akhe lang tuak a khezung guk, avek a sawmnih-le-li nei a-om a; amah leng miliante lak a khat ahi.
english: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.

paite: Ama'n Israel mite asimmoh a, David unau Shimea tapa Jonathan in amah athat hi.
english: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.

paite: Huaite Gath a milian lak a piang ahi uh; huaite David leh amite khut ah asi uhi.
english: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
